svg.aria-label: About Medwin Jose: I study and build systems that stay correct when some of their participants misbehave: networks where peers lie, markets where traders game the order book, and pipelines where one bad input should never take everything down. My work sits where distributed systems meet security, mostly in Rust. I like the unglamorous parts of engineering: specifying behaviour before writing code, testing properties instead of examples, and publishing every number with the command that produced it.
